source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Go to the relevant page for documentation for failed items.
3. Use the visual checklist to assist you.
4. Click on the image icon to take a photograph of item.
5. Use the audio record button to capture a recording of the item or any insights you have. 

**Please note that you do not have to take both audio and photo, these are used for documentation purposes to provide a robust review process.**

4. Repeat where appropriate to gain a detailed understanding of the item.

5. It is particularly important in failing an item to gain a full appreciation of why the item does not meet building access code. Often your understanding of why it does not work is as important as what it looks like.
